Yes, that's exactly how I hoped it'd come together. I clicked "design" on the A List Apart card and it narrowed to the design links just as before — and I could see the matching "design" in the label row above lit up too, so the two paths are clearly showing me the same thing rather than fighting each other. Whichever way I reach for a label, I end up in the same place with the same clear way back to everything.

So both filtering paths sitting side by side works, and neither gets in the other's way. The organizing-and-finding-by-label piece feels complete to me now.
